verdict.rationale: Qodo runs unattended on the Git provider side: it automatically reviews every pull request, reviews can be triggered automatically, and configuration can live in a .pr_agent.toml file. That delivers hands-off automation in the PR pipeline. The documented CLI, however, is framed for local use with a coding agent, and nothing shows a headless or non-interactive CLI mode, a CI-runner integration, or exit-code gating. Missing for 10: documented headless/non-interactive CLI invocation, explicit CI pipeline integration (e.g. GitHub Actions or GitLab CI usage), CI authentication/token setup, independent hands-on corroboration of CI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Once connected, Qodo automatically reviews every pull request
Trigger a Qodo code review manually or automatically, and control when reviews run on a pull request.
Manage Qodo configuration as code using a .pr_agent.toml file at the repository, project, group, or organization level.
Use MCP when you want to connect Qodo Agentic Toolbox managed skills to a remote or custom agent, workflow, or application.
